China's AI development expands beyond major cities

China is developing its artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities in locations beyond its major metropolitan centers, indicating a strategic shift in the distribution of key technological projects. This expansion aims to foster AI advancements across the country, potentially impacting how and where these critical technologies are developed and managed. Huawei is reportedly playing a project management role in developing components for advanced chip manufacturing, specifically for DUV machines, as a strategy to circumvent export controls.
